clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in Blackfathom Deeps, the Moonshrine Ruins lie flooded and seized by the Twilight's Hammer. Their halls once honored Elune, but the cult now carries out dark rituals among the ancient stones.

Beyond the cavernous Pool of Ask'ar, the Moonshrine Ruins lie along the Ashenvale coast. These partly submerged halls once echoed with chants to Elune, the Moon Goddess. The Great Sundering shattered the temple and drowned its lower levels in seawater. Now murky waters churn with aggressive crabs and serpentine threshadons. The Twilight's Hammer cult holds the stones and performs dark rituals that mock the shrine's sacred origins.
